ArgonTest.Name: Bytes from array
ArgonTest.InputSource:
module _
import Argon.Core::*
def read(bytes: Bytes)(index: Int)(requires erased ev: ((index >= 0 && index < bytes.length) == true)): U8 = bytes[index]
proc main(): () do let array = Array.newFilled 3 10u8 array[1] := 20u8 array[2] := 30u8
let bytes = Bytes.from_array array array[0] := 40u8 array[1] := 50u8 array[2] := 60u8
puts (bytes.length.to_s())
if bytes.length >= 3 then puts ((read bytes 0).to_s()) puts ((read bytes 1).to_s()) puts ((read bytes 2).to_s()) end end
